summary.prose: Building this fix moves the Story's scope decision onto the Story's own commits in one seam, then makes every consumer follow it. The git commit attribution (foreign trailers, strict scans, per-unit reads) and the git_diff stat failure come first; the shared change-set seam and the diff-only grounding build on them; the review subject, the BUILD records and the build gate's selection then drop their working-tree fallbacks. It ends with the observed case re-run on the installed daemon.

tasks.title: git_diff fails when its stat read fails
tasks.summary: In src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/diff.ts, a non-zero numstat exit after a successful body command returns success: false with an error naming the stat failure, instead of success with an empty file list.
acceptanceChecks: A git_diff run whose numstat command fails returns success: false and an error naming the stat read.
collectDiff and runDiff therefore reject it (no consumer change needed).

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/diff.test.ts: 'when the diff body command succeeds and the numstat command fails, git_diff returns success: false naming the stat failure'

tasks.title: storyChangeSet: foreign commits, strict scan, perUnit
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/runners/build/story-commits.ts: the trailer scan records carrying and foreign commits (all Insrc-Story lines name other Stories); with strict: true a failed git log throws NoBuildChangesError (newestStoryCommit stays lenient); one rule for ordinary, merge-edit and octopus units (foreign never a unit, its paths to the excluded set; carrying always; untrailered merge always; untrailered ordinary only in a legacy range); the result gains perUnit. The trailer test expectation at story-commits-trailer.test.ts:101 becomes ['src/a.ts'].
acceptanceChecks: With a storyKey, no unit of any kind comes from a foreign commit; untrailered merge edits are still units.
A range of only other Stories' commits gives an empty set.
strict: true turns a failed trailer scan into NoBuildChangesError.
perUnit is false only for an unfiltered legacy range.

src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/story-commits-trailer.test.ts: 'with strict, a trailer scan that cannot read the commit messages throws NoBuildChangesError instead of falling back to the first-parent range'

src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/story-commits-trailer.test.ts: 'a Story with no carrying commit keeps its untrailered commits and leaves out another Story's, so the range of src/a.ts and src/b.ts gives src/a.ts'

src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/story-commits-trailer.test.ts: 'a merge carrying only another Story's trailer is not a unit, two-parent or octopus, with and without a commit carrying this Story's trailer, while an untrailered merge edit still is'

tasks.title: changedFiles: the Story's commits first, own-file working-tree edits, excludedUncommitted
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/runners/build/changed-files.ts: with a base, read the Story's set first (storyChangeSet with storyKey and strict), choosing per-unit diffs by set.perUnit; then add working-tree paths already in that set and report the rest as excludedUncommitted on ChangeSetAttributionReport; a storyKey without a base throws NoBuildChangesError; collectBuildChangeLog forwards ctx.storyKey. Without a base, unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: With a base, an unrelated uncommitted file is never returned and is listed in excludedUncommitted.
An uncommitted edit to a Story file is returned.
A clean tree gives the committed-range result.
A storyKey without a base is refused, and collectBuildChangeLog turns it into [].
The changed-files.test.ts cases asserting that a dirty tree wins over the range are rewritten to the anchored rule.

tests.name: src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'with a base, an uncommitted change to a file no Story commit touched is left out and reported as excludedUncommitted, whatever else the tree holds'
src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'an uncommitted edit to a file the Story's commits changed is part of the Story's set'
src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'a clean tree gives exactly the committed-range set, trailer units and first-parent ranges alike'
src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'a storyKey without a base is refused, and collectBuildChangeLog turns it into an empty changeLog, never the working tree'

src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'a filtered legacy range reads each kept unit's own diff: a file another Story also edited, or later reverted, carries only this Story's change'
src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'a git_diff result that fails its stat read makes the anchored derivation refuse, never return an empty set'

tasks.title: Diff-only grounding: anchored, lossless hunks
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts: splitDiffByFile appends every section per path; workingTreeDiff sums staged and unstaged stats; storyRangeDiff chooses per-unit reads by set.perUnit; assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding reads the Story's units (strict) plus the working-tree hunks of files in that set, reports excludedFromScope, and drops the working-tree-first and last-commit steps (no base or a git failure raises DiffUnavailableError).
acceptanceChecks: A Story file with staged and unstaged edits keeps both sets of hunks and summed stats.
The grounding never carries an unrelated file's hunks or another Story's last commit.
No base raises DiffUnavailableError.
The diff-grounding.test.ts and diff-attribution.test.ts cases asserting working-tree-first or last-commit grounding are rewritten: no base and a git failure raise DiffUnavailableError.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/diff-attribution.test.ts: 'the diff-only grounding carries the Story's units and the working-tree hunks of its own files only, never an unrelated file's hunks or another Story's last commit'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/diff-attribution.test.ts: 'storyRangeDiff on a filtered legacy range grounds only the kept units' hunks of a file another Story also edited'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/diff-attribution.test.ts: 'a Story file with distinct staged and unstaged edits keeps both sets of hunks, and its stats are their sum, in the diff-only grounding'

tasks.title: Review subject and record: no fallbacks, excludedFromScope
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/code-review/subject.ts remove the two working-tree attempts (decline with 'no-build-record' on no base or a git failure), carry excludedFromScope, and restate the module header; add excludedFromScope to CodeReviewSubject and CodeReviewBody.subject in src/workflow/code-review/types.ts; stamp it in src/workflow/code-review/runner.ts; thread the diff-only result's excludedFromScope at src/daemon/code-review-rpc.ts:157 and src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/handler.ts:400-412.
acceptanceChecks: A resolved subject's attribution is never 'working-tree'.
Unrelated uncommitted files are listed in excludedFromScope on the subject and the record, absent when none.
No base or a git failure declines with 'no-build-record'.
The subject.test.ts and subject-attribution.test.ts cases asserting a step-down to the working-tree attempts are rewritten to declines.
A Story whose resolveStoryRangeBase returns undefined declines with 'no-build-record'.

tests.name: src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/subject-attribution.test.ts: 'a Story's review subject is its trailered commits plus edits of its own files; unrelated uncommitted files are left out and listed in excludedFromScope, and the attribution is never working-tree'

src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/subject-attribution.test.ts: 'with no resolvable range base, or git failing on the anchored derivation, the review declines with no-build-record and never reviews the working tree'
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/runner.test.ts: 'the review record stamps excludedFromScope beside changedFiles when uncommitted files were left out, and omits it when none were'

tasks.title: BUILD records: Story-scoped changeLog that replaces a prior one
tasks.summary: src/workflow/runners/build/completion-record.ts and src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases/validate.ts pass storyKey to collectBuildChangeLog and write changeLog whenever they pass it, even empty, so a re-write replaces a contaminated prior changeLog.
acceptanceChecks: A BUILD record's changeLog holds the Story's files and none of an unrelated uncommitted change.
Re-writing a record whose changeLog held unrelated files replaces it.

tests.name: src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'a BUILD record's changeLog, from the completion writer and the validate phase, holds the Story's files and none of an unrelated uncommitted change'
src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: 'rewriting a BUILD record whose changeLog held unrelated files replaces it with the Story-scoped changeLog, empty included'

tasks.title: Validate gate: Story-scoped typecheck projects and trivial tests
tasks.summary: In src/daemon/steps/build-step/validation-checks.ts: withTypecheckProjects and trivialCheckPlan take an optional storyKey and, with it, select from the Story's set synchronously (storyChangeSet strict plus own-file uncommitted and untracked paths; trivial tests filtered to files that still exist; no base fails the trivial listing); validate.ts passes the storyKey at 348 and 389.
acceptanceChecks: A project owning only unrelated uncommitted or untracked files is not in typecheckProjects; Story and test-file projects are.
A trivial build runs only the Story's existing test files; a deleted test is never asked to run.
Without a storyKey, results are unchanged.

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: 'with a storyKey, typecheckProjects holds the Story's projects and its test files' projects, and not a project that owns only unrelated uncommitted or untracked files'

src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: 'with a storyKey, the trivial plan runs only the Story's test files, and with no base fails the listing instead of running the HEAD commit's tests'
src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: 'with a storyKey, a trivial build that deletes a test file does not ask to run it'

The review record's changedFiles hold none of the unrelated uncommitted files, and excludedFromScope lists them.
